question: Who among the following was the commander of Muhammad Ghori, and also founded the slave dynasty in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Qutub-Din Aibak**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Qutb ud-din is another name for Qutb-ud-din Aibak.
 
• He was the founder of the **Slave dynasty**.
 
• He was also known as **Lakh Baksh **because of his generosity.
 
• He served as a **commander in Muhammad Ghori's army**.​
 
• He died in the year 1210 AD while **playing Chaugan or Polo**.
